summary: Tested NEW Placement Quiz frontend (Part 2) built on top of already-tested backend endpoints. Verified backend endpoints directly via curl (GET /api/auth/placement-quiz in en/de/es, POST /api/auth/placement-quiz/complete) -- all working, correctly localized, and complete correctly grants lessons/XP and returns placement_quiz_result. Full E2E Playwright testing of the onboarding flow: signup -> agreement -> experience screen -> 'some experience'/'advanced' -> 7-question placement-quiz -> calm completion screen (no XP shown) -> /(tabs). Also verified 'Beginner' choice skips the quiz entirely and goes straight to tabs (unchanged behavior). Verified full quiz UI + completion flow renders correctly in all 3 languages (EN/DE/ES) with no raw translation keys leaking. Regression-tested practice.tsx (unmodified) -- option selection, check/continue, correct/incorrect explain box all work as before. No bugs found.
action_items: No action needed. All acceptance criteria in the review request were verified working as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: placement-quiz.tsx correctly guards onboarding-never-blocked requirement: handles both loadError (network/auth failure) and empty questions array with the same fallback UI (placement.errorTitle/errorSubtitle) and a placement-continue button that routes to /(tabs).

Completion screen (done state) intentionally shows zero XP/reward numbers (verified via DOM text search for 'XP' -- not present), matching the 'CALM completion screen' requirement, unlike practice.tsx's result screen which does show +XP reward card by design (separate feature, correctly left untouched).
submit() in placement-quiz.tsx swallows errors silently and still calls setDone(true) in finally -- correctly ensures onboarding is never blocked even if POST /complete fails mid-flight.
experience.tsx correctly branches: beginner -> /(tabs), some/advanced -> /placement-quiz. Verified via live click-through for both paths.

All placement.* translation keys (q, of, check, continue, correct, notQuite, doneTitle, doneSubtitle, continueToApp, errorTitle, errorSubtitle, errorContinue) present and correctly translated in en/de/es dictionaries in translations.ts -- no missing keys observed in any of the 3 languages during live testing.

success_rate.backend: 100% (verified via curl: signup, placement-quiz GET en/de/es, placement-quiz/complete POST)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all E2E flows passed: some/advanced -> quiz -> completion -> tabs; beginner -> tabs skip; 3-language rendering; practice.tsx regression)

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_/test_ prefixed users via signup UI and curl for isolated test scenarios (test_placement_*, test_beginner_ui_*, test_de_ui_*, test_es_ui_*@example.com). No cleanup performed; not required per guidelines since no seeded/production data was modified. demo@tradequest.app used read-only for practice.tsx regression check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Placement Quiz frontend (Part 2) is fully functional and matches all requirements in the review request: correct branching in experience.tsx, full 7-question quiz UI with tier tags/progress/explain boxes, calm no-XP completion screen, error/empty fallback that never blocks onboarding, and correct trilingual rendering. Backend (Part 1, previously tested 10/10) remains unmodified and continues to work correctly. practice.tsx regression confirmed unaffected. No bugs found this iteration.
